identity.name: Clayton Fillyau
identity.summary: James Brown's drummer in the early 1960s, before Melvin Parker and Clyde Stubblefield.

contribution.description: Called the drummer who originated the funk beat in James Brown's band: his "stampeding drums" on "I've Got Money" (1962) are heard as a precursor of Brown's funk, and he said he learned his key rhythmic lesson from Charles "Hungry" Williams of New Orleans.
